notes_for_editor: Two sources. The Forest Lookouts page is a hobbyist site; the MDC annual report it cites was not checked directly. The removal is a bare 'Removed' label with no date or reason. The brief's coordinates match the NGS mark within about 40 m, and its 33.5 m height matches the NGS 110 ft. The Forest Lookouts page also carries a photo credit dated October 28, 2016 (Bob Frakes), with no description; if it shows the tower standing, it would conflict with the removed label, so the editor may want to check it. Staffing, fires, access and visit details are absent from every source read and are left out. The 1966 statewide count comes from the MDC 'Shooting the Smoke' page and is context, not a Seymour fact. Web search found no tower-specific history.
